entry_points.text: Guest share and unshare reject unaligned addresses; sharing on missing mapping synthesizes a write translation fault with encoded address and rewinds return by one instruction for host servicing and retry, and unsharing reports success only on completion.

Fixmap init creates one slot per CPU from private pages and shared data then the optional large block, stopping on first failure; power-on entry funnels into common routine that installs argument and target with disabled memory management state before transferring to host.

Protected hypercall dispatcher completes discovery, memory info, share and unshare locally with invalid parameter default else reports unhandled for host; system trap tries workaround then protected logic, and panic snapshots state, restores host, captures backtrace and never returns.

AArch64 identifier reads return filtered values while writes raise undefined; interrupt status reads report fixed enables for version three only, selected identifiers raise synchronous or undefined faults by feature field, and leaf capture records entry and level.

exports.text: Host ownership audit is callable from other hypervisor objects and validates tracking against host stage two entries across the private and vmemmap range.
Host power configuration is globally visible and fixed after early init, with per-CPU host data and global masks controlling trap delegation for system and debug accesses.
Tracing reserves timestamped variable entries on the calling CPU ring and commits the latest reservation, while restricted guest traps raise undefined exception and report handled.

hazards.text: Synchronous exception synthesis must refresh program position and status, synchronize virtualized controls, pend the exception, then install fault syndrome across levels, with undefined injection using unknown reason with length indication.
Table splits need an allocation cache and fail without it, shared page pinning can return null in protected mode, and concurrent stage two updates signal retry rather than blocking.

invariants.text: Host stage two uses single pages except standard memory and MMIO protections to avoid losing state on splits; fixmap slots capture one leaf then clear it with elevated table reference, and large block maps an aligned RAM window.
Hypervisor-claimed RAM must show hypervisor owned with host absent except read-only executable text; admission takes head page from host cache via host to hypervisor donation.

Hypervisor protection decode starts from software bits with execute inferred from never-execute controls; reference repair walks the full span to offset early allocation and ownership repair walks recorded regions and per-CPU stacks.

Protected guests see per-field ceilings on processor ID registers with vector and pointer-auth gated by predicates; reads return stored per-VM values or zero out of range or before init, read-as-zero ignores writes, and certain debug fields use nonzero encodings for absence.

Identifier groups delegate to filtered readers, debug and error groups use read-as-zero, host-handled entries leave dispatch empty for host emulation, and the table routes unallocated IDs and cache plus device IDs specially.

Block mapping needs level support with full granule coverage and alignment; stage two treats invalid-to-valid or non-permission change as update, uses exclusive store or compare-exchange with locked detection, while attribute and age walkers retry on contention and free ignores absent entries.
External warning, bitfield, per-CPU, alignment, atomic and page helpers provide checks, address math, fault encoding and reference counting; they are owned outside this dossier.

locks.text: Guest share and unshare take host lock then owning guest lock, hold both across validation and table updates, and release on all paths including early failure.
Machine table insertion and removal serialize on table lock, private reservation and mapping on page-directory lock, and each CPU power-on and suspend records start unlocked with one-shot publish.
Trace buffer mutation serializes on its spinlock, stage two aging requires address-space write lock, and installs use exclusive stores or shared compare-exchange with locked entry race detection.

state_machines.text: Guest sharing requires guest owned with host absent to reach shared owned and shared borrowed with reverse unshare; host and hypervisor cycle through donate, share, firmware handover and pin-busy, and guests add donate, reclaim and terminal poison.

Final init builds allocator, host stage two, callbacks, reference repair, fixmaps, ownership reconcile and verify, proxy and VM table and selftest, then publishes status and enters host; reconciliation mirrors derived ownership and maps executable text read-only, while stack walker offers locations until consumer declines.

Protected register emulation decodes access, searches restricted table, raises undefined if absent, punts to host if marked, else runs handler with conditional skip; trap tables split host and guest by exception class sharing SIMD, abort, watchpoint and memory handlers.

Hypervisor map tries leaf with offset and compatibility checks else allocates child table with ref increment, while unmap requires present entry, skips shared tables, clears with barrier and invalidation and releases refs counting bytes.

Stage two replacement locks slot with contention warning, invalidates VM-scoped, releases old ref, then installs ordered; leaf attempt enforces granularity and maintenance, walk collapses or splits tables, and unmap clears counted ownership and defers leaf invalidation by policy.

structs.text: Range validation pairs wanted state with helper deriving current state from entry and address; visitor succeeds on match else permission failure.
Hypervisor keeps global table object with lock, bounded RAM descriptors with count, private address allocator, and machine handle table installed once with build-time fit check.
Boot record holds sync cell, resume address and arg; feature ceiling holds signedness, position, width, max and predicate with zero width terminator; walks carry cursors and stage two context.
Trace singleton wires per-CPU rings with backing base and length and starts unlocked; hypervisor map argument pairs base physical address with attributes.

Handles start at 4096; reserved table entry is pointer sentinel 0xa110ca7ed; invalid CPU is unsigned max; memory fields use nonzero not-present encodings; unallocated IDs fix opcodes while varying control fields.
